title: REQ · Clicking bookshelf, computer, bed, window or door runs contextual actions updating flags, dialogue and inventory
summary: Every key object has actions that change real state including an inventory item
description: Context: only bookshelf search and computer search set flags; no action adds items, no action changes dialogue. Desired: bed search adds old-key, computer search sets computer_on and starts a dialogue, window inspect sets window_seen, door leave is conditional on hasItem old-key and sets door_unlocked. Expected: inventory and flags update via performAction. Why: interactions change real state.
acceptance_criteria: Given the bed, when search is performed, then inventory contains old-key and a history line is added
Given the computer, when search is performed, then flag computer_on is true
Given the window, when inspect is performed, then flag window_seen is true
Given no old-key, when door leave is attempted, then state is unchanged; with old-key it sets door_unlocked true
Given bookshelf search, then secret_door_open is true

out_of_scope: New action ids beyond inspect, push, search, leave

technical_constraints: Action ids limited to the actionSchema enum
